g.text: Component View: Pizzaco Order Service - Order API

Level 3, the hexagon only. Inbound adapters drive use cases, use cases orchestrate the domain, and outbound adapters satisfy the core's output ports. Actors, externals and wiring are omitted so the seam is the only thing to read.
